neighbours.label: position where a linking or auxiliary verb (become, come, be, have) is the expected next word
fire: Over the next century the small fishing village grew to become a major port.

The new film that has just premiered in New York is getting rave reviews.
Scientists believe the comet may come close to Earth again in 2061.
The old warehouse is set to become a museum of modern art.
Many of the rules that have been in place since 1990 will remain.
